entries.340e23652b72db46: The group consists of HIROSHIMA GAS CO.,LTD. (headquartered in Minami-ku, Hiroshima City), 25 subsidiaries and 14 affiliates (as of March 31, 2026). It runs the gas business, which handles city gas, the LPG business, which handles LP gas, and other businesses, including construction and elderly care services.
entries.7d8d8bbb4102798a: This business sells LP gas in areas not supplied with city gas. 22 companies, including Hiroshima Gas Propane Co., Ltd. and Hiroshima Gas Hokubu Hanbai Co., Ltd., also sell LP gas appliances and carry out LP gas piping work. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥17,847 million.
entries.90fd54ef45e6e4d6: This business manufactures, supplies and sells city gas, with Hiroshima, Hatsukaichi, Higashihiroshima, Kure, Onomichi, Mihara and Fukuyama as its main supply areas. Its main raw material, natural gas, is mainly imported from overseas by LNG carrier. It also supplies wholesale to other gas operators, sells gas appliances and performs gas equipment construction. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥67,625 million, the largest business in the Group.
entries.97a97ec8bb62bd98: A regional energy company that supplies city gas and LP gas mainly within Hiroshima Prefecture, and also handles electricity sales and services for the elderly.
entries.d08eb131b0703383: This business is engaged in engineering-related work such as open inspection of high-pressure gas facilities, construction work and installation of machinery and equipment, and elderly services such as elderly care. It is handled by Hiroshima Gas Techno Service Co., Ltd. and B Smile Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,923 million.
